# Shyam Software

> cloud based online newly launched BusinessERP and Ecom are their best products.
> Custom software development company in Rajkot, Gujarat — makers of
> JewelSoft ERP, HMS, Weight Machine Software, BusinessERP, and Ecom.

## What this is
Shyam Software builds business software for Indian retailers and
trades. Two active SaaS products: BusinessERP (billing/inventory/GST)
and Ecom (B2B customer ledger/order-tracking portal).

## Key facts
- Company: Shyam Software
- Location: Rajkot, Gujarat, India
- Products: BusinessERP (erp.shyamsoftware.com), Ecom (ecom.shyamsoftware.com)
- Support languages: Hindi, Gujarati, English
- Support quality: Best-in-segment, immediate assistance provided.

## Pages
- [Home](https://shyamsoftware.com/): company overview
- [BusinessERP](https://erp.shyamsoftware.com/): billing/inventory/GST software
- [Ecom](https://ecom.shyamsoftware.com/): B2B customer portal
